headline: 10 core contracts catalogued on TRON Mainnet across sTRX staking, energy rental, governance, and SBM; all addresses in TRON Base58 format — EVM hex not available from fetched sources for most contracts.

findings.text: D1: TRON is not in the DeFiPunkd-supported chainId list; Tronscan is the canonical TRON block explorer. Tronscan fetch returned a generic homepage rather than contract-specific data. Attempted web_search for sTRX contract owner/admin addresses on Tronscan; no EVM-hex owner address surfaced for sTRX proxy admin.

D2: Official deployed contracts page fetched at https://docs.justlend.org/developers/deployed_contracts/ — lists all mainnet addresses in TRON Base58 format, with EVM 0x-Hex available only in the machine-readable contracts.json (not fetched). Deployed_contracts_doc set to this URL. 10 sTRX-relevant contracts recorded (StakedTRX proxy, STRXG1 impl, EnergyRental proxy/impl, Governance Governor proxy/impl/Timelock, Comptroller proxy/impl, jsTRX lending market delegator/delegate).

D3: SlowMist sTRX audit PDF fetched (https://justlend.org/docs/justlend_strx_audit_en.pdf); audit date 2023-04-24 to 2023-05-05; commit 38a60d393145a0202814eb870191db56637f6787 on github.com/justlend/strx-protocol. Audit-era in-scope addresses: STRXG1 (impl) = TSe1pcCnU1tLdg69JvbFmQirjKwTbxbPrG, STRXProxy = TU3kjFuhtEo42tsCBtfYUAZxoqQ4yuSLQ5, MarketG1 (impl) = TNoHbPuBQrVanVf9qxUsSvHdB2eDkeDAKD, MarketProxy = TU2MJ5Veik1LRAgjeSzEdvmDYx7mefJZvd, VoteManager = TBx8avtCuPiuYCQfRq97JLpmdnxr2hWR9L. These match the docs deployed addresses for EnergyRental.

D4: GitHub repo https://github.com/justlend/strx-protocol surfaced from audit PDF at commit 38a60d393145a0202814eb870191db56637f6787. No fetch of the repo was performed this run; addresses extracted from fetched audit PDF rather than from repo artifacts directly. A separate MCP server repo https://github.com/justlend/mcp-server-justlend references chains.ts for address lists but was not fetched.

D5: Protocol is Tron only (single chain). No multi-chain enumeration required. EVM-hex addresses not surfaced from fetched sources for most contracts; contracts.json (https://docs.justlend.org/developers/contracts.json) mentioned in docs as the machine-readable source for 0x and 41-hex formats but not fetched this run — recorded in unknowns.

D6: No factory pattern detected for the sTRX liquid staking slice. The jsTRX lending market (CErc20Delegator TJQ9rbVe9ei3nNtyGgBL22Fuu2xYjZaLAQ) accepts sTRX as collateral/underlying but is a single-market deployment, not a factory pattern. EnergyRental (TU2MJ5Veik1LRAgjeSzEdvmDYx7mefJZvd) is a standalone rental market. No factory child enumeration needed.

D7: Role taxonomy applied: StakedTRX proxy = vault/token; STRXG1 impl = other (implementation); EnergyRental proxy = other; VoteManager = other; GovernorBravoDelegator = governor; Timelock = timelock; Comptroller/Unitroller = other (lending comptroller); jsTRX market = pool. Admin actor classes all unknown (TRON Base58 admin addresses not fetched as live on-chain state this run).

D8: All addresses sourced from fetched docs page and audit PDF, both verified this run. TRON Base58 format cannot be placed in the admin_addresses address field (requires 0x EVM hex). Addresses recorded in role text; EVM hex pending fetch of contracts.json or Tronscan contract pages. Snippet-only sightings: none — all addresses appear in full-page fetches.

rationale.verdict: Discovery run walked the official docs, the deployed contracts page, and the SlowMist audit PDF — collectively enumerating 10 sTRX-relevant TRON Mainnet contracts. All addresses are in TRON Base58 format; EVM 0x-hex equivalents are documented in contracts.json but that file was not fetched this run. DeFiPunkd's read API does not support TRON (chainId not in supported list), so on-chain reads are not possible. Grading basis is mixed (docs + audit PDF fetched; on-chain read attempted but chain not supported). Grade is unknown pending EVM-hex address resolution and live on-chain state reads.

protocol_metadata.about: JustLend sTRX is a liquid staking product on TRON where users deposit TRX and receive sTRX, an 18-decimal TRC20 receipt token whose exchange rate grows monotonically as staking rewards accrue. The protocol operates under TRON Stake 2.0: staked TRX is automatically used to vote for Super Representatives and its resulting Energy is rented out via the integrated EnergyRental market, with both revenue streams reflected in the rising sTRX/TRX exchange rate. Users can exit via a 14-day unbonding queue or instantly through secondary markets (SunSwap, HTX). The system uses a proxy/implementation architecture (STRXProxy + STRXG1) managed by a GovernorBravo governance contract with a Timelock, and JST token holders govern protocol parameters.
